description: Tahap 0 — Fondasi: Initialize the Next.js 15 project from scratch, set up all infrastructure (Neon Postgres connection, Drizzle ORM, Tailwind CSS, Zod, Vitest), create shared utilities (money, date, API response helpers, query helpers), build the base mobile UI design system (tokens, components, layout, bottom navigation), implement admin authentication (login/logout/cookie session/middleware), create the DB seed script, and prepare Vercel deployment config. Covers T0.1 through T0.11.
steps: 1. Initialize Next.js 15 project in workspace root with App Router and TypeScript using: `pnpm create next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias '@/*' --no-turbopack`. Accept defaults for all prompts. Confirm `pnpm dev` starts successfully.

2. Install additional dependencies: `pnpm add drizzle-orm @neondatabase/serverless zod jose`. Install dev deps: `pnpm add -D drizzle-kit vitest @vitejs/plugin-react @vitest/ui dotenv`. Pin exact versions.

3. Create `.env.example` with: DATABASE_URL=<your-neon-postgres-connection-string>, NEXTAUTH_SECRET=<random-32-char-string>, NODE_ENV=development. Add `.env.local` to .gitignore. Do NOT create a real .env.local — instruct developer to copy .env.example.
4. Create `drizzle.config.ts` at project root pointing to `src/db/schema/index.ts`, output `src/db/migrations/`, using `@neondatabase/serverless` driver.
5. Create `vitest.config.ts` at project root with React plugin, path aliases matching tsconfig, and `environment: 'node'` for server-side tests.
6. Create `src/db/index.ts` — export Drizzle client using `neon()` from `@neondatabase/serverless` and `drizzle()`. Guard with `process.env.DATABASE_URL` check.

7. Create directory structure: `src/db/schema/`, `src/db/migrations/`, `src/lib/`, `src/features/`, `src/app/api/v1/`, `src/components/ui/`. Add package.json scripts: `db:generate` (drizzle-kit generate), `db:migrate` (drizzle-kit migrate), `db:seed` (tsx src/db/seed.ts), `db:seed:demo` (tsx src/db/seed-demo.ts), `db:reset` (tsx src/db/reset.ts).

8. Create `src/lib/money.ts`: integer rupiah utils — `formatRupiah(amount: number): string`, `roundUpToMultiple(amount: number, multiple: number): number` (rounds 11250 with multiple 1000 to 12000). No floats. Export these as named exports.

9. Create `src/lib/money.test.ts`: Vitest unit tests for `roundUpToMultiple` — cases: 11250→12000 (×1000), 0→0, exact multiple stays, 1→1000, negative multiple throws. Run `pnpm vitest run src/lib/money.test.ts` — all pass.

10. Create `src/lib/date.ts`: WIB timezone utils — `toWIB(date: Date): Date`, `formatDateWIB(date: Date): string` (DD/MM/YYYY), `getNextPlayDay(playDays: number[], from?: Date): Date` where playDays are 0-6 weekday numbers.

11. Create `src/lib/api-response.ts`: typed helpers — `successResponse<T>(data: T, message?: string, status?: number)`, `paginatedResponse<T>(data: T[], meta: PaginationMeta, message?: string)`, `errorResponse(message: string, errors?: Record<string, string[]>, status?: number)`. PaginationMeta: `{ page, per_page, total, total_pages }`. All return `NextResponse`.

12. Create `src/lib/query-helpers.ts`: parse and validate `page`, `per_page`, `search`, `sort`, `sort_dir` from URL search params using Zod. Return 422 `errorResponse` on invalid input. Export `parseListQuery(searchParams: URLSearchParams)`.

13. Create `src/app/api/v1/health/route.ts` as a working example endpoint returning `{ data: { status: 'ok' }, meta: { pagination: null }, message: 'OK' }` — proves the response helper and API routing work.

14. Create design tokens in `src/lib/design-tokens.ts`: color palette (solid, no gradients), spacing scale (min 44px for touch targets). Apply tokens as Tailwind CSS custom colors in `tailwind.config.ts`.

15. Create base UI components in `src/components/ui/`: `Button.tsx` (min h-11/44px, variants: primary/secondary/ghost/danger), `Input.tsx` (with label, error state), `Card.tsx`, `BottomSheet.tsx` (animated slide-up), `Toast.tsx` + `useToast.ts` hook, `Stepper.tsx` (number input with +/- buttons), `Chip.tsx` (selectable tag), `Badge.tsx` (status display). Mobile-first, 360px safe.

16. Create `src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx` with max-w-[430px] container, bottom navigation bar (`src/components/layout/BottomNav.tsx`) with 5 tabs: Beranda (home), Pertemuan (calendar), Kas (wallet), Pemain (users), Lainnya (menu). Each tab is a Next.js Link to its placeholder page.

17. Create placeholder pages for all 5 nav tabs: `src/app/(protected)/page.tsx` (Beranda), `src/app/(protected)/pertemuan/page.tsx`, `src/app/(protected)/kas/page.tsx`, `src/app/(protected)/pemain/page.tsx`, `src/app/(protected)/lainnya/page.tsx`.

18. Create DB schema file `src/db/schema/auth.ts` with tables: `grup` (id, nama, kode_unik, dibuat_pada), `admin` (id, grup_id, nama, email, password_hash, aktif, dibuat_pada), `grup_admin` (grup_id, admin_id, peran), `sesi_admin` (id, admin_id, grup_id, dibuat_pada, kedaluwarsa_pada). Export all from `src/db/schema/index.ts`.

19. Implement authentication in `src/features/auth/`: `hash-password.ts` (bcryptjs hash/compare), `create-session.ts` (sign JWT with jose, set httpOnly cookie 'session'), `verify-session.ts` (verify JWT, return admin payload). Install `bcryptjs` and `@types/bcryptjs`.

20. Create `src/app/api/v1/auth/login/route.ts` (POST): validate email+password with Zod, query admin by email+grup, compare hash, create session cookie, return success. Create `src/app/api/v1/auth/logout/route.ts` (POST): clear session cookie.

21. Create `src/app/login/page.tsx` — login form (email, password), calls POST /api/v1/auth/login, redirects to / on success, shows error toast on failure. This page is public (not in (protected) group).
22. Create `src/middleware.ts`: intercept all routes except /login and /api/v1/auth/*; verify session cookie; redirect to /login if invalid or absent.

23. Create `src/db/schema/config.ts` with tables: `konfigurasi_grup` (grup_id PK, harga_bola_per_biji, isi_per_tabung, biaya_lapangan_non_member, iuran_bulanan, kelipatan_pembulatan, hari_main (array int), biaya_sewa_default, stok_awal, diperbarui_pada), `kategori_kas` (id, grup_id, nama, tipe: 'pemasukan'|'pengeluaran', adalah_sistem: boolean, aktif). Add `log_aktivitas` (id, grup_id, admin_id, aksi, entitas, entitas_id, detail jsonb, alasan, dibuat_pada). Export from index.

24. Create `src/db/seed.ts`: insert initial grup ('Badminton Grup A'), admin (email: admin@example.com, password: 'admin123' hashed), konfigurasi_grup defaults (harga_bola: 5000, isi_per_tabung: 12, biaya_lapangan_non_member: 10000, iuran_bulanan: 50000, kelipatan_pembulatan: 1000, hari_main: [2,5] (Selasa=2, Jumat=5), biaya_sewa_default: 100000, stok_awal: 0), and 6 default kategori_kas: Tagihan Pertemuan (pemasukan, sistem), Kelebihan Bayar (pemasukan, sistem), Iuran (pemasukan, sistem), Pembelian Bola (pengeluaran, sistem), Sewa Lapangan (pengeluaran, sistem), Sponsor (pemasukan, non-sistem). Script must be idempotent (upsert or check-first).

25. Create `vercel.json` at project root with build config, and confirm `pnpm build` runs without errors (mocking DB connection if needed). Add `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1` pattern or build-time env check so build doesn't fail without real DATABASE_URL.
26. Create a component gallery page at `src/app/gallery/page.tsx` (public, no auth) showing all UI components at 360px width — Button variants, Input, Card, BottomSheet, Toast, Stepper, Chip, Badge.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm vitest run` passes all tests (money rounding unit tests)
`pnpm build` completes with zero TypeScript and build errors
`pnpm db:generate` and `pnpm db:migrate` succeed (given a valid DATABASE_URL)
`pnpm db:seed` is idempotent and creates initial grup, admin, config, and kategori_kas
GET /api/v1/health returns the standard response shape
Login page exists at /login and submits to /api/v1/auth/login
All 5 bottom nav tabs render placeholder pages at 360px without horizontal scroll
findings: Implemented on Next.js 16.4.1 (create-next-app@latest installs v16, not v15 as spec stated — all App Router features are present). Next.js 16 renamed middleware.ts to proxy.ts with export named `proxy` instead of `middleware`. Tailwind v4 uses CSS-only config (no tailwind.config.ts); design tokens applied via @theme in globals.css. Drizzle ORM v0.45 uses neon-http driver (not neon-serverless) with neon() query function. drizzle-kit v0.31 no longer accepts 'neon-serverless' as driver — plain postgresql dialect with url credential works. Vitest v5 requires @types/node ^22. vitest.config renamed to .mts for clean ESM. All 3 verification commands pass: 8/8 tests, clean build, zero lint errors.
